title: [ARKNIGHTS X NINE-COLORED DEER]: IMMEMORIAL BRIGHT LIMITED-TIME LOGIN EVENT OPEN
lines: 01 [ARKNIGHTS X NINE-COLORED DEER]: IMMEMORIAL BRIGHT LIMITED-TIME LOGIN EVENT OPEN
DETAILS: Players can log in to receive the event operator [★★★★★：Nine-Colored Deer] and exclusive event furniture 'Amidst Misty Clouds'.

◆ Players who have already obtained the Operator Nine-Colored Deer through the Display of Auspices Login Event cannot receive it again; Players who have already obtained the furniture 'Amidst Misty Clouds' through the Display of Auspices Login Event cannot receive it again.
02 [ARKNIGHTS X NINE-COLORED DEER]: [CROSSOVER] COLLECTION NEW ARRIVALS AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following new Outfit will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
- CROSSOVER Collection - A Silvern Caress On the Flow of Time for Nine-Colored Deer
[Outfit Voucher] cannot be used to redeem the collab outfits.
03 EPOQUE COLLECTION RE-EDITION AT OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
- EPOQUE Collection - Justice Maker for Wild Mane
Please stay tuned for more information!
